The cost is this base-object variant: the cartridge has no D2 anywhere -- no symbols.txt row in any module names 0x-anything as _ZN12daBombking_cD2Ev, and the only references to the destructor pair in config/ are vtable slots 16 and 17, which name D1 (0x02123740) and D0 (0x02123798). Genuinely homeless, so plain deadstrip.

include/types.h gives Vector3 a declared, empty destructor (the ROM destroys arrays of it). Four members of this TU hold Vector3 locals, which odr-uses it, so mwcc emits a vague-linkage copy. The cartridge keeps the canonical copy at arm9:0x020072c0 (4 bytes, `bx lr`), outside this TU's licensed range, so dsd supplies it independently.

This TU owns every virtual member, so it is the class's key-function TU and mwcc emits the vtable. The cartridge keeps it at ov078:0x02126e4c -- the ADDRESS POINT, not the storage start; storage begins at 0x02126e44 with the offset-to-top and typeinfo words. Extent corroborated by three independent tools: the relocated run is 0x02126e48..0x02126ec4 with a real gap before the next data symbol at 0x02126ee0; rtti_vtables.py --own daBombking_c reports 31 slots (base dEnemyBase_c also 31); romdata_check.check_object reports bytes 124, emitted 124, blindWords 0. 124/4 = 31 slots; storage size is 0x84 (8-byte preamble + 31 slots). Note romdata_check's romExtent field reads 148 here and is WRONG -- the truthful fields are bytes/emitted.

HOMELESS, and the reason is the class name. The cartridge's own RTTI string at ov078:0x02126e18 is `12daBombking_c`, so the ROM's typeinfo record is configured as _ZTI12daBombking_c -- there is no _ZTI12daBombking_c row in any module's symbols.txt. The class is still spelled daBombking_c here because all 51 of its method symbols are, and a text-only promotion does not touch symbols.txt. Until a separate rename lands, this emitted copy has no ROM home and is plain deadstrip.
